definitions.label: Independent paid activations
definitions.definition: Distinct non-founder customers with a provider-confirmed payment and an accepted first artifact in the cohort; refunds and test purchases excluded.

definitions.label: Customers repeating within 7 days
definitions.definition: Distinct activated customers who complete a second accepted task within 7 days; only mature cohorts enter the denominator.

definitions.label: Contribution after direct costs and valued time
definitions.definition: Earned sales excluding tax/pass-throughs, minus attributable refunds, payment/channel/FX/acquisition/compute/tool/fulfillment/support and valued owner time. No mixed-currency total.

definitions.label: Accepted outcome rate
definitions.definition: Accepted eligible task runs divided by all eligible task runs in the fixed evaluation cohort, with repeated trials separately identified.

definitions.label: Support minutes per active workspace-month
definitions.definition: All customer-support minutes divided by active workspace-month equivalents, excluding separately sold delivery time.
